meta.author: Common phrases that I chose; I defined the axes and what each one means
meta.note: 180 labeled phrases (25+20 per axis). Replace or extend with human-written phrases.

axes.N: V north: we, future, possibility, connection
axes.S: I south: cold, fear, absence, past, hard logic
axes.E: Lv east: me first, defense of the self, subjective opinion
axes.W: Gv west: empathy, calm, toward you
